_comment: Asset manifest (ENGINEERING_CONSTRAINTS.md §12). Every art file under assets/ must appear here; the validator fails the build on one that does not. Engine sidecars (*.import) and Godot resources (*.tres/*.res) are not art and are not listed. Every entry's status is 'placeholder' because these are free Mana Seed demo files, to be re-sourced at the vertical slice [A14], and because their terms are unverified — EC-12a is an OPEN pre-launch gate and until it closes none of these may be used as AI input or style reference. 'pack' values are taken from the filenames, not from any pack listing.
